---
title: Projects
description: Every entry in your directory is a YAML file under data/records/. How to author one, what fields are available, and what validation checks.
---

Every project in your directory is a YAML file under `data/records/`. One file per project. `kind: project`, a slug, a name, a description, and you're done.

The full field reference is in **[Project record schema](/reference/record-schema/)**. Step-by-step authoring is in **[Author a record](/guides/author-a-record/)**.

To import an existing awesome list instead of writing each YAML by hand, see **[grove import](/reference/cli/#grove-import)**.
